title: Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables with Cross-Account Read Access
description: Deploy an Amazon DynamoDB global table with an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role that grants another AWS account read-only access in both Regions.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon DynamoDB global table (same-account, multi-Region) with an IAM role for cross-account read access.
The reader account assumes the IAM role with an external ID and can query the table in either Region.
DynamoDB handles replication automatically with sub-second latency between regions.
Point-in-time recovery is enabled for data protection.

bullets.text: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support replication across AWS accounts

text: See the README for testing instructions.
